Bilkul. Neeche 100 Roman Urdu questions hain jo ek pharmacy owner aapke LLM Konnect RAG chatbot se pooch sakta hai. Maine simple database lookup ke saath analytical aur decision-support questions bhi include kiye hain.
Sales aur Revenue
1. Aaj meri total sale kitni hui hai?
2. Kal meri total sale kitni thi?
3. Is mahine meri total sale kitni hui hai?
4. Pichle mahine meri total sale kitni thi?
5. Pichle 7 din mein kitni sale hui hai?
6. Is mahine meri average daily sale kitni hai?
7. Is mahine sab se zyada sale kis din hui?
8. Is mahine sab se kam sale kis din hui?
9. Pichle 30 din ki sales ka trend kya hai?
10. Is mahine ki sale pichle mahine se kitni different hai?
11. Meri sales mein pichle mahine ke muqable mein kitne percent izafa ya kami hui?
12. Is saal ab tak meri total sale kitni hui hai?
13. Aaj kitne sales bills bane hain?
14. Meri average bill value kitni hai?
15. Aaj ka sab se bara sales bill konsa tha?
16. Is mahine ke top 10 sab se bare bills konse hain?
17. Hafte ke kis din sab se zyada sale hoti hai?
18. Kis waqt ya time period mein sab se zyada sale hoti hai?
19. Is mahine customers ko total kitna discount diya gaya?
20. Meri sales kam ho rahi hain ya barh rahi hain?

34. Meri slow-moving medicines konsi hain?
